osorio_p2.name: EE-T1 Osório (120)
osorio_p2.authority: Main ruled the Brazil line on 2026-10-29 (DECISIONS) on the owner's request the same day ("lets build brazil, not taiwan, and flesh it out with all its own tanks") and the owner's direct ask ("EE-T1 Osório. use our tank generation specs"): the 120 mm P.2 at tier IV, a photo-class first-party primary build; no registered 3D comparison exists. Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified.
osorio_p2.envelopeBasis: Width, length and tallest are the as-built envelope of the shared Osório build (profiles/osorio.ts): published 7.13 m hull, 10.10 m over the 120 mm gun, 3.26 m over the skirts, 2.37 m to the turret roof and 2.89 m to the sight (Engesa's sheet in Forças Terrestres 2015; Jane's via Nita 2014). The envelope holds the skirts' bolt strips (3.29 m over them, the published 3.26 m), the M2HB on the loader's pintle and the two antenna whips; the stations are Engesa's three-view scaled on the hull (the overall length checks at 10.08 m), the CIBld (2020) and 2022 parade photographs.
